articles.title: A major NFT marketplace is shutting down—5 years after the boom, there's a lesson for investors
articles.summary: For investors, it's a cautionary tale about spotting the warning signs before buying into the next craze, financial experts tell CNBC Make It. "When the buyers stopped coming, there was nothing holding up the price." For everyday investors, the NFT bust is a reminder that an asset's popularity doesn't necessarily make it a worthwhile investment. If an investor can't answer those questions, he says, the investment may not belong in the portfolio at all.

articles.title: Nvidia's Colette Kress confronts key questions in first earnings report since Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.summary: While the company is again expected to show explosive growth as the key infrastructure provider to the artificial intelligence boom, Kress and her team will likely be forced to answer questions on chip sales to China, the risks tied to deals with neoclouds and what comes next under new leadership. Huang resigned Thursday, but Nvidia's legions of customers, partners and investors still rely on the company to continue shipping large quantities of graphics processing units and AI systems.

articles.title: Nvidia shares under pressure as calls grow for Huang to be reinstated as CEO
articles.summary: There has been a lot of debate over the real versus the perceived value of the "Jensen premium." But today, the bears are back, sending Nvidia shares lower premarket despite speculation that Huang could be pushing to make a return to the AI firm. - IMF warning: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva says the global economy is "on the AI leg," warning that the overdependence risks the world's financial stability.

articles.title: AI is reshaping banking jobs – but its ability to drive profits remains unclear
articles.summary: Banks' third-quarter results have brought their use of artificial intelligence into sharper focus, as lenders automate routine work, reshape hiring and test whether productivity gains can translate into revenue growth. This earnings season, Barclays unveiled layoffs in certain functions where AI is being deployed; while UniCredit and Santander said technology was freeing employees for higher-value work and improving processes.

articles.title: China’s slowdown deepens in October as industrial output, retail sales, investment miss estimates
articles.summary: China's economic slowdown worsened in October with retail sales, investment and industrial output all missing economists' estimates, as analysts warn a growing reliance on external demand leaves growth more exposed to shocks abroad. Growth in the world's second-largest economy bounced off three-year lows in the third quarter, expanding 4.5% from a year earlier.

articles.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite
articles.summary: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracted in the third quarter, shrinking at an annualized 0.1% compared to the previous quarter, as elevated energy prices weighed on consumption and net exports. A Reuters poll of economists had estimated the economy to grow at 0.3% in the three months to September, while GDP had expanded at 1.4% in the previous quarter.
